groups.name: Extend the evidence — more datasets, domains, models, scale
groups.exemplar: Expand evaluation to additional datasets or tasks to demonstrate robustness and scalability.

groups.name: Fix the surface — typos, notation, figures
groups.exemplar: Correct typos, add missing notation, and clarify figure captions.

groups.name: Measure the true cost — runtime, memory, GPU-hours
groups.exemplar: Report inference-time savings and runtime measurements to demonstrate actual speed improvements.

groups.name: Strengthen the theory — proofs, bounds, guarantees
groups.exemplar: Provide theoretical results on learnability or optimizability.

groups.name: Justify assumptions & scope the claims
groups.exemplar: Justify the assumption or acknowledge its limitations.

groups.name: Articulate the contribution
groups.exemplar: Articulate a clearer principle behind the method's design.

groups.name: Release & document — code, data, repro details
groups.exemplar: Clarify reproducibility details, code release plans, and LLM usage.

groups.name: Situate in the literature
groups.exemplar: Deepen engagement with specific prior works and clarify differentiation.

groups.name: Validate against humans & the real world
groups.exemplar: Conduct a validation study comparing model outputs to human judgments.

groups.name: Show it on real visual data
groups.exemplar: Investigate more tasks with real-world images to provide more convincing evidence.

groups.name: Report error bars & significance
groups.exemplar: Report mean ± std or confidence intervals across multiple runs.

groups.name: Ablate the components
groups.exemplar: Isolate components through ablation studies to demonstrate their individual contributions.

groups.name: Stress-test under attack & shift
groups.exemplar: Demonstrate robustness across different model scales and under adversarial attack.

groups.name: Analyze the failures
groups.exemplar: Identify and report specific failure modes or conditions where the approach does not work well.

groups.name: Probe hyperparameter sensitivity
groups.exemplar: Conduct a sensitivity analysis to demonstrate robustness to hyperparameter variations.
